relationships.subject: Deferoxamine
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that NRF2 and HO-1 protein levels were dramatically suppressed in the EAP group and significantly elevated in the DFO or EDA group

relationships.subject: Deferoxamine
relationships.evidence_quote: It was revealed that these agents had greatly avoided the activation of the RhoA/ROCK1 pathway and α-SMA expression in the EAP model

relationships.subject: Deferoxamine
relationships.evidence_quote: a significantly increasing number and percentage of activated/degranulated mast cells were observed in EAP group, which were ameliorated by DFO and EDA

relationships.subject: Deferoxamine
relationships.evidence_quote: the upregulation of inflammatory mediator COX-2 and downregulation of immunomodulatory factor IL-2 were reversed obviously in the presence of DFO and EDA

relationships.subject: Deferoxamine
relationships.evidence_quote: the increased production of cytokines in the EAP group, including IL-6, VCAM-1, and BDNF, was significantly reversed in the DFO and EDA groups

relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: its encoded protein COX-2 can catalyze the metabolism of PUFAs, especially arachidonic acid (AA), into prostaglandin isoforms PGE2

key_findings: Ferroptosis markers (low GPX4/Xc-, high ACSL4/LPCAT3, iron overload) were found in experimental autoimmune prostatitis rats.
Ferroptosis inhibitors DFO and EDA reduced inflammation, RhoA/ROCK1 fibrosis, mast cell activation, COX-2 and BDNF, and restored NRF2/HO-1.
